✨ Rich and decadent molten lava cakes filled with a silky gooey chocolate filling. These lave cakes are super easy to make with just 5 ingredients in under 20 minutes. They make a delicious dessert or Valentine’s day treat! 📌Full printable recipe with tips for different size bowls and alternatives is on my website gimmedelicious.com (link in bio)  Ingredients  ▢ 4 oz bittersweet chocolate ▢ 4 oz butter ▢ 2 large eggs ▢ 1/2 cup sugar ▢ 2 Tablespoons flour ▢ 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ▢ 1/2 teaspoon Instant coffee or espresso powder, optional   Instructions  Preheat oven to 400°F. Generously butter and dust 4 (4 oz) ramekins with cocoa powder or sugar; set aside. In a medium microwave-safe bowl, melt chocolate and butter in 30-second increments. In a separate large bowl, whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and fluffy. Whisk in the melted chocolate along with the flour, vanilla, and instant coffee if desired. Divide batter into ramekins and place them on a baking sheet. Bake 10-12 minutes or until the edges begin to pull away from the ramekins but the center is still jiggly. Remove from oven and serve immediately with ice cream. #recipes #chocolate #lavacakes #valentinesday #food #baking #bakersoftiktok #bakingrecipe

Heat oven to 450°F (230°C). 	2.	Butter two 4-oz ramekins, dust with flour, and tap out excess. 	3.	Melt chocolate (microwave or double boiler). Stir in butter until smooth. 	4.	In a separate bowl, whisk egg, yolk, and sugar until pale. 	5.	Stir egg mixture into melted chocolate, add flour, and whisk to combine. 	6.	Divide batter between ramekins. 🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or anyone who loves desserts that are out of this world! 🌠 #GalaxyCake #MirrorGlaze #ChocolateDessert #CosmicBaking #ShowstopperCake

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

🍫 Chocolate Molten Lava Cake Ingredients * ½ cup semi-sweet chocolate chips * ⅓ cup butter * 2 eggs * 2 egg yolks * ¼ cup sugar * ¼ cup all-purpose flour * Butter, for greasing ramekins * Cocoa powder, for dusting * Powdered sugar, for garnish Instructions 1. Prepare the ramekins: Preheat your oven to 425°F. Generously butter the inside of the ramekins, then dust with cocoa powder, shaking out any excess. 2. Melt the chocolate: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and butter. Microwave in 30-second increments, stirring well after each, until completely melted and smooth. Set aside. 3. Mix the eggs: In a separate bowl, add the eggs, egg yolks, and sugar. Beat for about 2 minutes, until the mixture becomes lighter and slightly thickened. 4. Combine: Add the flour and melted chocolate mixture to the egg mixture. Mix until everything is completely combined and smooth. 5. Fill the ramekins: Divide the batter evenly between the prepared ramekins. 6. Bake: Place in the preheated oven and bake for 12–13 minutes. The edges should be set while the center remains soft. 7. Rest and remove: Let the cakes sit for 1–2 minutes after removing them from the oven. Carefully loosen the edges with a knife if needed, then invert onto a serving plate. 8. Serve: Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately while the center is warm and gooey. 🍫✨#fyp #viral #fypシ #cake #chocolate

🌋🤎 Mini Dark Chocolate Lava Cakes 🤎🌋 Ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) salted butter 6 oz dark chocolate  2 eggs 2 egg yolks 1/4 cup unpacked brown sugar (40g) 2 tbsp flour Pinch of salt For serving: Powdered sugar Vanilla ice cream Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. 2. Grease 6 cups in a standard muffin tin with butter. 3. Melt: Melt butter & chocolate together in a saucepan over low heat, or in the microwave on high. Stir every 30 seconds until smooth.  4. Mix batter: In a medium bowl, beat eggs, egg yolks, brown sugar, & salt until slightly thickened. Whisk in the chocolate mixture. Fold in the flour until just combined. 5. Fill the tin: Divide batter among 6 of the muffin tin cups (about 3/4 full). 6. Bake: Bake for 7–9 minutes. Pull them out as soon as the tops set. 7. Cool & serve: Let sit for 2–3 minutes before serving. Gently remove the cakes from the muffin tin. Serve with a dusting of powdered sugar & vanilla ice cream. Cokelat pekat dan mint segar berpadu dalam mousse gunung meletus yang mewah tanpa oven. Bahan simpel, hasil elegan—cocok buat ide frozen dessert atau camilan cantik di rumah. Simak resepnya dan tag sahabatmu yang wajib cobain juga! 🍫 --- Volcano Mint Choco Mousse Cake ❄️🌋 (Kue Mousse Cokelat Mint Gunung Meletus Beku) 🍰 Bahan A – Mousse Cokelat Mint Cream cheese: 250 gram Gula pasir halus: 30 gram Whipping cream cair (bisa pakai merek Anchor/Elle & Vire): 150 ml Gelatin bubuk: 10 gram (rendam dulu dengan 3 sdm air dingin, biarkan mengembang) Susu UHT hangat: 80 ml Cokelat chip atau dark compound chocolate cincang: 40 gram Sirup mint (bisa pakai sirup daun mint botolan atau pasta mint): 50 ml 🍫 Bahan B – Dekorasi Whipping cream cair: 30 ml Dark chocolate: 20 gram Ceri segar atau kalengan: 4 buah --- 👩‍🍳 Langkah Pembuatan: 1. Campurkan cream cheese dan gula pasir dalam mangkuk, aduk menggunakan whisk atau mixer kecepatan rendah hingga lembut dan halus. Tambahkan whipping cream, aduk hingga tercampur rata. 2. Panaskan susu hangat, lalu masukkan gelatin yang sudah direndam, aduk hingga larut sempurna. Tambahkan cokelat dan sirup mint, aduk rata hingga cokelat mencair. 3. Tuang campuran gelatin ke adonan cream cheese, aduk rata perlahan hingga semua tercampur halus. Tuang ke dalam cetakan silikon berbentuk bulat atau setengah bola. Simpan dalam freezer selama 6 jam atau hingga benar-benar beku. 4. Ganache: Lelehkan dark chocolate dan whipping cream secara terpisah di microwave selama 30 detik, lalu campurkan keduanya dan aduk hingga mengkilap. 5. Keluarkan mousse dari cetakan, tuang ganache hangat di atasnya untuk efek meleleh seperti gunung berapi, lalu hias dengan ceri di atasnya. Sajikan beku untuk sensasi segar-lumer di mulut! #ResepKue #Dessert #Mousse #MousseTanpaOven #FrozenDessert #KueMint #KueEnak #KueAntiGagal #IdeCemilan
